basis: Pre-registered two-sided falsification criteria: what would confirm the hypothesis, and what would change our mind and retire it. These are proposed decision rules written before any strategy was run; they are not findings, effects or performance claims. Every test named here needs official settlement data and, where prices appear, licensed rows in the pricing store.

Availability-adjusted line versus market.confirms: With licensed prices in the store, the availability-adjusted fair line earns positive closing-line value at the pre-registered threshold on a prospective sample, after de-vigging.
Availability-adjusted line versus market.kills: The prospective CLV lower bound is at or below zero, or the adjustment moves the line away from the closing line on balance.

Backup QB start – total under.confirms: On official game books naming a backup starter at quarterback, the pre-registered total-under rule shows positive Brier skill versus the no-information baseline over a multi-season official sample.
Backup QB start – total under.kills: The skill interval includes zero, or unders and overs split evenly in the backup-quarterback subsample.

Control: favorites only.confirms: As a control it succeeds by being beaten: a candidate must out-earn this baseline on the same games to be considered skilful at all.
Control: favorites only.kills: A leaderboard run that omits this control beside every strategy is invalid and its results are discarded.

Control: random side each game.confirms: As a control it succeeds by being beaten: a seeded random side is the luck benchmark every candidate must outscore on Brier skill.
Control: random side each game.kills: A leaderboard run that omits this control beside every strategy is invalid and its results are discarded.

Cross-game parlay value.confirms: A directly validated joint probability for the leg set, from official settlement data with published n, differs from the operator price after the void/push rules are applied.
Cross-game parlay value.kills: No validated joint probability exists, or the operator price sits inside the joint price interval; no combo is ever ranked.

Defensive depth deficiency (secondary/li.confirms: A pre-registered ablation comparing identical models with and without verified defensive-absence features shows opponent scoring forecasts improving on official chronological holdouts, interval above zero.
Defensive depth deficiency (secondary/li.kills: The ablation difference interval includes zero, or the effect appears only in seasons used for fitting.

Divisional compression.confirms: Adding a divisional-game indicator improves spread or total forecasts over the team-strength baseline in a pre-registered chronological comparison, lower bound above zero.
Divisional compression.kills: No out-of-sample improvement, and the indicator is retired.

Injury-news timing reaction.confirms: Forecasts updated only after official status changes beat stale baselines on proper scores in a pre-registered replay with clock-time stamps.
Injury-news timing reaction.kills: The replay shows no improvement, or the update cannot be recorded before the market moves.

Injury-status change fade.confirms: When a starter moves to Out on the official Friday designation, the pre-registered fade rule earns positive closing-line value against licensed closing prices, lower bound above zero.
Injury-status change fade.kills: The CLV lower bound is at or below zero, or the closing line already fully reprices the change.

Line movement after injury news (CLV).confirms: With licensed price snapshots at official news timestamps, post-news quotes differ from closing quotes in the pre-registered direction at the declared threshold.
Line movement after injury news (CLV).kills: No systematic difference remains after de-vigging, or the direction reverses out of sample.

Net injury differential – spread.confirms: A pre-registered net-availability count from official reports and game books explains spread-forecast residuals beyond the team-strength baseline, interval above zero.
Net injury differential – spread.kills: The interval includes zero once opponent quality and market information are controlled for.

Offensive line replacement – rushing und.confirms: Official game books naming backup offensive linemen are followed by lower rushing output than the pre-registered prop baseline implies, on samples settled from official stats.
Offensive line replacement – rushing und.kills: No under bias in the subsample, or its interval includes zero.

Offensive-line replacement stress.confirms: The pre-registered ablation shows team-scoring forecasts improve when verified offensive-line availability features are included, on chronological holdouts, interval above zero.
Offensive-line replacement stress.kills: The ablation difference interval includes zero.

Opponent-adjusted team strength.confirms: Rolling opponent-adjusted efficiency beats the simple baseline on Brier skill over pre-registered holdout games, lower bound above zero.
Opponent-adjusted team strength.kills: No out-of-sample skill gain over the simple baseline.

Pace and possession efficiency.confirms: In a pre-registered walk-forward on the official game log, the total forecast using neutral pace and points-per-possession beats the raw-points baseline on Brier score, with the game-cluster lower bound above zero.
Pace and possession efficiency.kills: The lower bound touches zero, or the gain vanishes on the holdout block; pace and possession then add nothing beyond raw scoring and the strategy is retired.

Practice-trend signal (DNP→LP→FP).confirms: Multi-season official designations joined to official inactives show the DNP-to-LP-to-FP progression raising play probability over LP-to-DNP, with an interval excluding no difference, computed before any model uses the label.
Practice-trend signal (DNP→LP→FP).kills: The interval includes no difference, or the direction reverses out of sample.

Pythagorean luck regression.confirms: Clubs whose win total exceeds the Pythagorean expectation regress toward it in later official results, in the pre-registered direction, interval above zero.
Pythagorean luck regression.kills: No regression beyond chance, or the gap is already inside the closing line.

Quarterback availability shock.confirms: The pre-registered ablation comparing identical models with and without verified quarterback-availability features shows improved team-scoring forecasts on official holdouts, interval above zero.
Quarterback availability shock.kills: The ablation difference interval includes zero.

Quarterback-out offence fade.confirms: Fading the side missing a verified starting quarterback earns positive prospective closing-line value at the pre-registered threshold against licensed closing prices.
Quarterback-out offence fade.kills: The CLV lower bound is at or below zero.

Rating-mismatch spread.confirms: Entries taken only when the model margin disagrees with the licensed closing line by more than the pre-registered threshold earn positive Brier skill and CLV prospectively.
Rating-mismatch spread.kills: Either lower bound is at or below zero.

Receiver opportunity prop.confirms: Official participation and target data show reception and yardage forecasts improve when verified personnel-shift features are included, on pre-registered prop samples settled from official stats.
Receiver opportunity prop.kills: No improvement over the prop baseline, or settlement cannot be sourced officially.

Receiver target-share prop.confirms: Pre-registered volume props settled from official stats show positive skill versus the market-implied baseline once licensed prices exist.
Receiver target-share prop.kills: No skill edge, or the share signal is stale by kickoff.

Rest and schedule asymmetry.confirms: Published schedule facts (byes, Thursday turnarounds, international travel) improve forecasts over the baseline in a pre-registered comparison, interval above zero, before any price comparison.
Rest and schedule asymmetry.kills: No gain from the schedule features, or the gain is smaller than the vig.

Running-back workload prop.confirms: Verified rising snap and carry share from official participation data predicts rushing props better than the pre-registered baseline, interval above zero.
Running-back workload prop.kills: No predictive gain, or the workload is already priced at kickoff.

Rushing workload prop combo.confirms: A directly validated joint probability for the workload legs exists from official settlement data with published n, and the operator void/push rules are documented.
Rushing workload prop combo.kills: Either is missing, and the combo stays unranked.

Same-game parlay: QB passing yards over.confirms: A validated joint probability from official settlement data with published n exceeds the independence product, and the operator price does not reflect the gap.
Same-game parlay: QB passing yards over.kills: The joint probability is not validated, or the price already reflects it.

Same-game script combination.confirms: Conditional joint modelling of game-script legs beats marginal multiplication on held-out official settlements, interval above zero.
Same-game script combination.kills: No advantage over marginals, or the joint sample is below the pre-registered n.

Secondary attrition versus the pass.confirms: Official game books naming backup defensive backs show opponent passing efficiency rising, in a pre-registered ablation on official data, interval above zero.
Secondary attrition versus the pass.kills: The ablation difference interval includes zero.

Secondary replacement exposure.confirms: Coverage-role-weighted availability features improve passing forecasts on official holdouts versus the same model without them, interval above zero.
Secondary replacement exposure.kills: No improvement, or the coverage role cannot be established from official sources.

Team total under + game total under (par.confirms: A validated joint probability from official settlements with published n prices the pair differently from the operator price after void/push rules.
Team total under + game total under (par.kills: No validated joint probability, and the pair is never ranked.

Three-leg same-game script parlay.confirms: A directly validated three-leg joint probability from official settlement data, with published n, shows the operator price materially above the joint price.
Three-leg same-game script parlay.kills: The joint probability is not validated, or the price gap sits inside its interval.

Two-leg cross-game parlay.confirms: Cross-game legs are near-independent in official settlement data with published n, so the de-vigged product rule prices the combo within its interval; edge exists only if the operator price differs.
Two-leg cross-game parlay.kills: The legs are not independent in the data, or the operator price matches the joint price.

Two-leg same-game parlay (team total + s.confirms: A validated same-game joint probability with published n shows the independent-leg price is materially wrong in the pre-registered direction.
Two-leg same-game parlay (team total + s.kills: No validated joint probability, or the mispricing is inside the interval.

Uncorrelated 2-leg parlay of two single.confirms: As a control it succeeds when the correlation-adjusted method beats the unadjusted product rule on held-out official settlements.
Uncorrelated 2-leg parlay of two single.kills: A run that omits this control for combo divisions is invalid and its results are discarded.
